scope: Source-checked waypoint/gate specification. IDs are observations only; no event calls, flags, warps or direct damage are commands.

steps.name: Lower the shield with ID Card
Speak to Sue and complete the egg scene
Return to Arthur's House through teleporter
steps.note: Original transfer also runs Pens2 700 and Shelter 700; record every stage.

steps.name: Leave Arthur's House to check on Sue
Return the key to Santa
steps.note: Interact again if initial conversation only describes lost key.

steps.name: Defeat a Giant Jelly and collect Jellyfish Juice
steps.note: Native Giant Jelly death creates its chest; fire actual weapon then open chest.

steps.name: Talk to Kazuma through the crack
Pull MALCO out of the floor
Ask MALCO to make the bomb
Use Juice on Santa's fireplace for Charcoal
Open Gum Base chest and start Balfrog
Defeat Balfrog
steps.note: Shoot the open mouth; damage must reach native stage-boss component0.

steps.name: Leave Shelter with Kazuma and Professor
Watch Kazuma and Professor leave for the village
Return to Arthur's House via the Grasstown teleporter
Defeat Curly and deny wanting to kill Mimigas
steps.note: Optional following machine-gun trade can be declined to keep Polar Star.

steps.name: Ask the Colons about Jenka and her puppy
Take the chest puppy through pawprint passage
steps.note: Original walk-through walls marked with pawprints must retain passability.

steps.name: Bring Deserted House puppy to Jenka
Catch the running puppy
steps.note: The actor moves; use its live position.

steps.name: Carry last puppy across the original trigger
steps.note: Trigger at(40,24) requires four returned dogs flag593 and currently carrying flag274.

steps.name: Watch red-flower scene and defeat Frenzied Toroko
Climb Labyrinth I and activate exit panel
Ask the physician for a cure request
Take Cure-All and defeat Puu Black
Cross the gap and enter Boulder Chamber
steps.note: Best route skips wounded Professor and performs the original long jump.

steps.name: Push the boulder from its left side
Use first console again to lower lift
Investigate the damaged robot with Curly
Defeat Core and survive the drowning scene
Follow currents into Main Artery
steps.note: Best route must visit and finish Cabin before River220 death trigger; passing it while carrying undrained Curly sets irreversible851.

steps.name: Defeat Ironhead through original swimming sequence
Return to Arthur's House after Core
Teleport to the ruined Egg Corridor
Reach Egg No. 00 in ruined corridor
Read hatching terminal and speak to Kazuma
